Name: Witchy Flower Dance Dresses by b0rszcz for Fashion Sense
Author: b0rszcz
Description:
Flower dance dresses! They turned out much less "witchy", that I wanted them to be, lol. This means I'll have another attempt in the future.


[b]Compatibility:
[/b]- 1.6 update
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15730]FS - Rainmoon's Elf Ear[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/176632323]ItsRainmoon[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7732]Expressive Elf Ears FS and Overlay[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/106647918]GoblinHours[/url]

[b]Requirements: 
[/b]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4112039]PeacefulEnd[/url]

[b]How to Install:
[/b]- Unzip the file
- Move the folder into your StardewValley/mods folder
- Use a hand mirror (purchasable at Pierre's)
- Done!


This mod is inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] flower dance dresses.
